extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.
NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sets material requirements for equipment used in H2S-containing oil and gas production.

faqs.q: What is the Burner/Flare Boom Hose used for?
faqs.a: The Burner/Flare Boom Hose is used for offshore well-test flowback to the flare boom, carrying hot produced fluids. It is a well service hose in 2" to 6" bore, rated 5000 psi WP (well test flare line), from the Continental range.

faqs.q: What does the 5000 psi WP (well test flare line) rating of the Burner/Flare Boom Hose mean?
faqs.a: The rating is a working pressure (WP), the continuous service rating, so the Burner/Flare Boom Hose is rated 5000 psi WP (well test flare line) in 2" to 6". The hydrotest is 1.5 times working pressure per the listing; a test pressure is never a working pressure.

faqs.q: What bore sizes does the Burner/Flare Boom Hose come in?
faqs.a: The listing gives 2" to 6" inside diameter for the Burner/Flare Boom Hose, with flanged end fittings. Sizes outside the range can be quoted with a longer lead time. Give the inside diameter and assembly length on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Should I choose the Burner/Flare Boom Hose or the Well Test Production Hose?
faqs.a: The burner and flare boom hose has a heat-resistant liner rated to 200 °C in 2 to 6 inch, while the well test production hose is the sour-service 100 °C hose in 2 to 4 inch. See the [Well Test Production Hose](/p/well-test-production-hose).

faqs.q: What is the temperature range of the Burner/Flare Boom Hose?
faqs.a: The listing gives -30°C to +200°C (high-temp produced fluids) for the Burner/Flare Boom Hose. Sour-service and high-temperature variants exist for most families, so give the wellbore conditions on the RFQ for an engineering review.

faqs.q: What are the liner and reinforcement of the Burner/Flare Boom Hose?
faqs.a: The liner is Heat-resistant FKM / HNBR and the reinforcement is multiple high-tensile steel cable plies + heat-shielding. The flanged couplings are fitted to suit the Burner/Flare Boom Hose. Match the liner to the fluid, because the liner decides chemical resistance.

faqs.q: Which API standard does the Burner/Flare Boom Hose meet, and is it API monogrammed?
faqs.a: The listing gives API Spec 7K-equivalent for the Burner/Flare Boom Hose. It is supplied by API-licensed manufacturers to API 7K with the API certificate and monogram documentation issued with the order, and a test certificate with each assembly. Read the [API 7K, 16C and 16D guide](/blog/api-7k-16c-16d-which-standard).

faqs.q: What end fittings does the Burner/Flare Boom Hose use?
faqs.a: The Burner/Flare Boom Hose uses flanged end fittings. Flanges are API 6A or API 6BX, raised-face or ring-joint, so state the flange size, pressure class and gasket type on the RFQ; ring gaskets are in the [ring joint gasket range](/c/ring-joint-gaskets). See the [oilfield hose guide](/blog/oilfield-hose-guide).

faqs.q: How should I inspect and replace the Burner/Flare Boom Hose?
faqs.a: Inspect the Burner/Flare Boom Hose for cover damage, kinks, leaks and end-fitting movement at each rig move or as your procedure requires, and retire it per the maker's guidance and your records. Plan replacements around permits; see the [rig-site hose replacement guide](/blog/rig-site-hose-replacement-abu-dhabi) and the [guide for this hose type](/blog/well-service-and-stimulation-hose).

faqs.q: How does the Burner/Flare Boom Hose compare with the Well Test Production Hose?
faqs.a: The burner and flare boom hose has a heat-resistant liner rated to 200 °C in 2 to 6 inch, while the well test production hose is the sour-service 100 °C hose in 2 to 4 inch. See the [Well Test Production Hose](/p/well-test-production-hose).
